name: Sea Chest
subtitle: Milestone escrow
description: Example 9 — buyer escrows native coin, approves milestones to release seller funds, refunds the rest anytime. Approvals are irreversible; exits cost 5 state units.
long_description: Two-sided escrow for milestone work. The buyer deposits once at deal creation; each approveMilestone moves the specified amount into the seller's withdrawable balance. Unapproved remainder is refundable by the buyer at any moment — even under the emergency brake, since refunds and withdrawals are exits. Milestone amounts are specified at approval time instead of a stored array: the chain proves how much was released, the off-chain agreement holds the schedule. Irreversible approvals are what make the accounting race-free.
